rows.why: FlakyCo is not an existing customer, and nothing attached to the request shows that its operator has the required financial stake of at least 10,000 USD. The mandate itself is within scope: place_order, 3,000 USD against a 5,000 limit. I can't extend credit to an operator whose accountability isn't shown, so the order is declined. A public price quote is available: 150 units of X-200 comes to 2,778.75 USD. FlakyCo can resubmit the order with proof of its stake.
